reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product per price version
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
  WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
)
SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (list_price_eur - prev_price) / prev_price, 1) AS pct_change
FROM versions
alternatives:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product per price version
  SELECT p.product_id, p.valid_from, p.list_price_eur,
    (SELECT MAX(p2.valid_from) FROM price_history p2 WHERE p2.product_id = p.product_id AND p2.valid_from < p.valid_from) AS prev_valid_from
  FROM price_history p
  WHERE p.product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
)
SELECT v.product_id, v.valid_from, v.list_price_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (v.list_price_eur - h.list_price_eur) / h.list_price_eur, 1) AS pct_change
FROM versions v
LEFT JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = v.product_id AND h.valid_from = v.prev_valid_from

SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (list_price_eur - LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from))
    / LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from), 1) AS pct_change
FROM price_history
WHERE product_id BETWEEN 1 AND 25
